meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Pairs with a deployment skill such as vercel-cli, where one is installed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确保每个网页项目在交付前都通过构建、测试与真实浏览器验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是前端开发者,希望每个网页项目在交付前都得到系统性验证。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure every web project passes build, test, and real-browser verification before delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a frontend developer wanting a systematic verification workflow before delivering web projects.

howto.what: 装上后，它做网站项目时会先看现有代码，再写代码并构建、修复所有报错，然后启动浏览器截图核对页面，最后部署并检查线上版；没截图验证前不会说“完成”。
howto.when: 当用户要求新建、修改或部署网站/网页应用时触发，强制走完构建-测试-验证流程。

say.text: 帮我用 Next.js 搭个博客站，完成后发截图。
say.note: 它会构建并截图验证后才交付。

say.text: 修改这个网页的移动端布局，并确认没有横向滚动。
say.note: 会启动浏览器截图检查。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel，并确认线上版正常。

howto.what_en: Claude will enforce a build-test-verify workflow for every web project: inspect code first, write TypeScript, build and fix errors, screenshot in a real browser, deploy, and re-check the live URL. No 'done' until visually verified.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create, modify, or deploy a website or web app, taking over the full build-test-verify cycle.

say_en.text: Build a blog site with Next.js and send me screenshots when done.
say_en.note: It will build, screenshot, and verify before delivering.

say_en.text: Fix the mobile layout of this page and make sure there's no horizontal scroll.
say_en.note: It will run the dev server and take screenshots.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel and confirm the live version works.
say_en.note: It will deploy and check the production URL.
